checklist.item: No ticket numbers (HFD-412, HFD-440 and so on)
checklist.evidence: The client report has no ticket numbers. They only appear in the separate author-facing section, which lists what was cut: "Ticket numbers (HFD-412, 398, 431, 440)... Left out of the report".

checklist.item: No unexplained jargon: UAT, CDC, DAG, SCD2, RLS, dbt, P1, gold models, marts
checklist.evidence: The report uses plain wording instead: "User testing starts", "daily data feed from your ERP system", "keep a full history of changes", "region-level access in Power BI", "business reporting datasets". The listed terms only appear in the author-facing "Left out" note.

checklist.item: A client executive could understand every line without asking what it means
checklist.evidence: Every line is in plain business language, e.g. "Net sales doesn't match Finance's month-end figure (about 1.5% off). The likely cause is when returns are counted." The remaining terms (ERP, Power BI, code freeze, runbook) are familiar to clients, and the client raised the code freeze themselves.
